report.explanation: Current evidence shows healthy checkout: order trace OK at 70ms, gateway 200s, error_rate 0.0014, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. The deployment record only proves version facts (3.0.0, prior 3.0.9) and cannot establish deployment-caused failure. No current evidence substantiates checkout failures or any taxonomy cause, so the operator hypothesis is unsupported and no bounded candidate can be formed. Handing off for failure-specific telemetry.
missing_evidence: Checkout failure/error telemetry (5xx, error rates, failed spans) for order and gateway during the incident window
Deployment timing relative to failure onset; deploy record shows version 3.0.0 with 1580-minute age and no causal link
Downstream dependency health (payment, inventory, postgresql, redis) latency and error metrics
Gateway/order resource metrics (db_pool_waiters, dependency_timeouts) over a longer window to assess pool exhaustion or timeouts
